title: mcptest: automated tests and lint for MCP servers
problem: MCP server authors test by hand in the Inspector; nothing runs tool calls, schema snapshots and description checks in CI.

title: MCP server for the Bruno API client
problem: Agents can't run or edit Bruno API collections.

title: MCP server for AppFlowy
problem: No solid way to read and write AppFlowy docs and databases from Claude, Cursor or other agents.
reason: 2026-11-12: AppFlowy Cloud is adding MCP itself (AppFlowy-Cloud PR #1633) and at least eight community AppFlowy MCP servers exist.

title: MCP server for OWASP Dependency-Track
problem: Security teams want to ask an agent which projects use a vulnerable component.
reason: 2026-11-12: open request with 18 upvotes in the Dependency-Track repo; the existing community servers (drewrukin/dtrack-mcp, msiemens/dtrack-mcp, pluries and daniel-brenner-fnt dependency-track-mcp-server) have 0-1 stars each, so none is established. Shipped as bomscout.

title: MCP server for linkding bookmarks
problem: Search and save self-hosted bookmarks from an agent.

title: MCP server for Atlantis (Terraform pull request automation)
problem: Agents can't read Atlantis plans, locks and apply status.
reason: 2026-11-12: the requester proposed a native MCP server inside the Atlantis binary and an ADR for it is open upstream (runatlantis/atlantis#6720); an external server would be replaced by it.

title: MCP gateway that loads servers only when a tool is first used
problem: Many configured MCP servers flood the context window and slow start-up.
request_query: mcp lazy load servers in:title is:issue
reason: 2026-11-12: the big requests were answered in the clients (Claude Code #7336 and Codex #9266 closed with tool search / deferred loading), and about ten small lazy-loading proxies already exist (voicetreelab/lazy-mcp and others).

title: Drop-in OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, discovery) for HTTP MCP servers
problem: Server authors struggle to add the OAuth flow MCP clients expect.

title: mcptest for vitest and Jest
problem: Most MCP servers are TypeScript; they need the same tests in their own test runner.
request_query: mcp server (vitest OR jest) test in:title is:issue
reason: 2026-11-12: the official MCP Inspector (11k stars, pushed today) now describes itself as deterministic testing tools for MCP servers, and the top matches were not requests for a vitest/Jest plugin.

title: trips: split a GPS track into stays and trips
problem: Turning raw location pings into places visited and journeys between them.
reason: 2026-11-08: movingpandas (TrajectoryStopDetector/StopSplitter, 1k+ stars, maintained) and scikit-mobility already detect stays and split trips; the search matches were noise.

title: elevation: honest elevation gain from noisy GPS
problem: Elevation gain from GPS tracks is badly overstated; apps disagree by 20 percent or more.
reason: 2026-11-12: the top requests are Android/Java apps (RunnerUp, OpenTracks, GraphHopper) that cannot use a Python package, and gpxpy (1.1k stars, pushed this week) already gives smoothed uphill/downhill for Python users.

title: Trajectory similarity (Frechet, DTW, Hausdorff) for tracks
problem: Compare or deduplicate routes; the known library is unmaintained.

title: Make location tracks safe to share
problem: Hide home and work endpoints and add calibrated noise before sharing tracks.
request_query: "location privacy" (gps OR trajectory OR anonymize) in:title is:issue
reason: 2026-11-08: no real requests found; matches are about OS location indicators and privacy policies, not GPS track anonymization.

title: Detect harsh braking, acceleration and cornering from GPS alone
problem: Telematics without an OBD device.

title: Resolve and validate OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) in authorization servers
problem: MCP clients now identify themselves with a URL client_id, and authorization servers have to fetch, validate and cache that document safely; every server is re-implementing it.

title: RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata and 401 challenges for HTTP MCP servers
problem: Remote MCP servers advertise the wrong resource URL, scheme or scopes in their protected resource metadata, so clients cannot start OAuth.
reason: 2026-11-12: the official MCP Python and TypeScript SDKs already serve RFC 9728 metadata and 401 challenges when auth is configured; the top requests are client bugs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI ignoring scopes_supported) and SDK bugs, not a missing library.

title: MCP Tasks extension (long-running tool calls) for Python MCP servers
problem: Long-running tool calls time out; the Tasks extension fixes it but servers have no easy way to adopt it.

title: Read-only mode and tool allow/deny lists for Python MCP servers
problem: Every MCP server re-implements a read-only mode and tool filtering by hand, and most get it wrong (writes leak through, hidden tools stay callable).

title: Confirm destructive MCP tool calls, with a fallback for clients without elicitation
problem: Servers want a human to confirm destructive tools, but many clients do not support elicitation, so the guard is either skipped or the call fails.
request_query: mcp elicitation (confirm OR confirmation) destructive in:title,body is:issue

title: Make MCP and agent tool schemas accepted by Gemini and strict OpenAI
problem: Gemini and OpenAI strict mode reject ordinary JSON Schema ($ref/$defs, anyOf with null, type arrays, arrays without items, non-string enums, missing required), so one MCP tool breaks every request; each client hand-rolls a sanitizer.
repo_query: json schema gemini openai strict tool in:description

title: Paginate or trim oversized MCP tool results before they hit the client's token limit
problem: MCP tools return results larger than the client's limit (Claude Code caps at 25k tokens), so the call fails; servers need cursor pagination and safe truncation.
repo_query: mcp tool response pagination truncate in:description

title: Return MCP tool results that every client reads: structuredContent validated against outputSchema plus a matching text block
problem: Clients disagree on structuredContent (some drop it, some drop the text block), and servers that declare outputSchema but return mismatched or missing structured output get rejected by conformant clients.
reason: 2026-11-11: top requests are client bugs (clients drop structuredContent or the text block); a server library can't fix those, and the Python SDK already emits both from outputSchema.

title: Add correct MCP tool annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint) to servers that lack them
problem: Many MCP servers ship tools without annotations, so clients cannot tell read-only tools from destructive ones and ask for approval on everything.
reason: 2026-11-11: requests are per-project asks to add annotations or framework/client support (vercel/ai, fastapi_mcp); correct hints depend on each tool, so there is no reusable library to build.

title: Per-client rate limits, quotas and concurrency caps for MCP tool calls (official Python SDK)
problem: Hosted MCP servers get flooded by agents that call tools in loops or in parallel bursts, and the official MCP Python SDK has no rate limiting; projects hand-roll it or return HTTP 429, which clients treat as a connection failure.
request_query: rate limit mcp tool calls in:title is:issue
repo_query: mcp rate limit tool calls in:name,description
reason: 2026-11-12: many projects add MCP tool-call rate limits by hand, but no request has upvotes (score 19); revisit if a request gains traction. FastMCP (standalone) already ships rate-limiting middleware.

title: Structured, redacted audit log of every MCP tool call for Python MCP servers
problem: Teams running MCP servers need a record of which client called which tool with what arguments and result, with secrets redacted, and each project writes its own.
repo_query: mcp audit log tool calls in:name,description

title: Migrate Python MCP servers from SDK 1.x (FastMCP) to 2.x (MCPServer)
problem: MCP Python SDK 2.0 renamed FastMCP and changed many APIs, so unpinned servers crash with No module named 'mcp.server.fastmcp'.
reason: 2026-11-12: real breakage (1,000+ issues mention mcp.server.fastmcp since July), but two active Python codemods already ship it on PyPI (dheerajjha/mcp-migrate with 21 rules, 8crsk/mcp-codemod), and most projects just pin mcp<2; a third tool adds little.

title: Stdio proxy that keeps only JSON-RPC on an MCP server's stdout
problem: Any banner, log line or print() on a stdio MCP server's stdout breaks the JSON-RPC stream and the client fails the handshake; every project fixes it by hand and users wait for upstream releases.
request_query: stdout in:title stdio in:title mcp is:issue
reason: 2026-11-13: real and frequent (198 issues titled stdout+stdio+mcp) but each is one server's bug with few upvotes (score 54 with a precise query); a fix-from-outside stdio proxy is still a good candidate.

title: Install SEP-2640 skills served by MCP servers into hosts that lack the extension
problem: MCP servers now serve skills (SEP-2640) but Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex and goose don't load them yet.

title: Serve a folder of SKILL.md skills over MCP (SEP-2640) from the official Python SDK
problem: The Python SDK's Skills support is merged but unreleased and has no filesystem provider.
reason: 2026-11-13: FastMCP 4.1.2+ (SkillsDirectoryProvider + SkillsExtension) and the official Python SDK (merged) already serve skills folders; little gap.
